bodies.name: Proxima Centauri
bodies.nativeSurface: Native Hubble WFPC2 point-source image, not a resolved photosphere. R675/I814 filters include near infrared; displayed colour is not calibrated visible colour.
measured: Ribas et al. 2017 infer effective temperature 2980±80 K, radius 0.146±0.007 solar radii, mass 0.120±0.003 solar masses and luminosity 0.00151±0.00008 solar luminosities from radiative observations/models.
Hubble WFPC2 records the unresolved star; release 2013-10-28. Exact observation date is not independently verified.
modelled: A fully convective low-mass hydrogen/helium plasma star; effective temperature is a spectral fit, not a resolved surface thermometer.
unknown: Resolved magnetic-region geography, convective cell sizes and contrast, detailed abundance fractions, chromospheric geometry and calibrated visible raster colour.
assumed: Independent photospheric intensity map with invented convective mottling and two dimmer magnetic regions; no observed solar map reused.
Observer at two photospheric radii from centre, one radius above the photosphere, with artistic 120-degree horizontal field. No ground or physically survivable observer implied.
Ribas 2017 adopted values differ from earlier planetary dossiers (2900 K / 0.141 solar radii); those dossiers and catalogue fits remain preserved.
